mapper.sql: user_id, user_name, password, phone, avatar, intro, role AS user_role, register_time, status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (user_name, password, phone, avatar, intro, role, status, register_time) VALUES (#{row.userName}, #{row.password}, #{row.phone}, #{row.avatar}, #{row.intro}, #{row.userRole}, 0, #{row.registerTime})
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(user_id AS CHAR) AS userId,user_name AS userName,avatar,intro FROM sys_user WHERE user_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM sys_user ORDER BY user_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password=#{newHash} WHERE user_id=#{id} AND password=#{oldHash}
